sources.name: RepDB exercise dataset free tier

source_code_license.name: MIT License
source_code_license.notes: The code license does not govern the exercise JSON or WebP assets.

content_licenses.scope: free-tier exercise JSON and associated WebP image assets
content_licenses.name: RepDB Free Tier License
content_licenses.notes: Commercial in-app use is permitted with attribution and the recorded restrictions.

permitted_use: Personal or commercial use inside applications.
Resize, crop, or recolor approved free-tier images for in-app use.
prohibited_use: Redistribute or repackage the dataset or a derivative as a dataset, repository, or API.
Use images as generative-model input, reference, conditioning material, or training data.
Use paid-tier preview animations in production.
redistribution_constraints: In-app use only; public source-repository vendoring remains unresolved and requires explicit legal/licensor confirmation before artwork is committed.
modification_constraints: Resize, crop, and recolor are permitted for in-app use; derivatives retain the no-dataset-redistribution rule.
Upscaling and background removal do not relax redistribution constraints.
sources.intended_indifit_usage: Candidate source for manually approved local exercise movement illustrations only; RepDB metadata never becomes canonical IndiFit data.
open_questions: May RepDB artwork be committed to the IndiFit source repository if that repository is or becomes public, or must acquisition occur through a private build path?

sources.name: MuscleMap

content_licenses.scope: body and muscle vector path geometry distributed in the repository
content_licenses.name: MIT License
content_licenses.notes: File-level path provenance must still be recorded before a Flutter port is committed.

attribution.text: MuscleMap copyright (c) 2026 Melih Colpan; MIT License

permitted_use: Use, copy, modify, merge, publish, distribute, sublicense, and sell under MIT terms.
prohibited_use: Import geometry before file-level provenance and taxonomy-adapter review.
Let the upstream taxonomy override IndiFit B02 or exercise classification.
redistribution_constraints: Include the MIT copyright and permission notice in copies or substantial portions.
modification_constraints: Record the exact source files and all port/conversion modifications.
sources.intended_indifit_usage: Candidate primary geometry source for a future local Flutter muscle renderer under the B05 presentation boundary.

sources.name: openGym

source_code_license.name: GNU Affero General Public License
source_code_license.notes: The repository was documented as AGPL-3.0 but was no longer retrievable through Git at acquisition time; no source was copied.

content_licenses.scope: exercise data and media referenced by openGym
content_licenses.name: Separate upstream terms
content_licenses.notes: openGym documentation attributes exercise content to hasaneyldrm/exercises-dataset; it is not covered by openGym's AGPL license.

prohibited_use: Copy AGPL source, functions, snippets, converted code, assets, or derived implementation structure into IndiFit.
redistribution_constraints: No openGym content is redistributed by IndiFit.
modification_constraints: Not applicable because no openGym material may be imported.
sources.intended_indifit_usage: Clean-room reference only; IndiFit implementations must derive from frozen requirements and B01/B02 authority.
open_questions: The upstream repository could not be pinned because it was unavailable through Git on 2026-08-20; this does not relax the prohibition.

source_code_license.name: MIT License
source_code_license.notes: The MIT grant explicitly excludes images and videos.

content_licenses.name: Gym visual terms; upstream permission is not a downstream license
